wake.speaker: The Void
wake.text: You have fallen [shake]far[/shake], little light. Farther than the ink was meant to reach.

choices.text: (3 shards) I can pay to pass.

who.speaker: The Void
who.text: I am the [glitch]dark[/glitch] your ink has not yet named. Name me and we begin.

silence.speaker: The Void
silence.text: Silence. Good. The deep prefers those who listen before they draw.

offer.speaker: The Void
offer.text: Three sparks, already spent on fear. You [glitch]bargain[/glitch] before you understand the price.

gift.speaker: The Void
gift.text: Then the ink owes you a debt. It is not kind to its creditors.

hub.speaker: The Void
hub.text: The descent forks. Where does your ink pull you?

flee.speaker: The Void
flee.text: There is no up. There is only [whisper]less down[/whisper]. Choose again.

memory.speaker: The Murmurs
memory.text: The murmurs are old lights that [flicker]stopped drawing[/flicker]. They still remember how.

listen.speaker: The Murmurs
listen.text: They say your name the way water says a stone: slowly, and then all at once.

deeper.speaker: The Void
deeper.text: Down is the only honest direction here. Will you fall, or will you [wave]draw[/wave]?

draw.speaker: The Void
draw.text: Good. [wave]Draw[/wave]. The walls remember every stroke you make down here.

fall.speaker: The Void
fall.text: Falling is only [shake]drawing[/shake] without a hand. The dark will hold the pen.

trial.speaker: The Void
trial.text: Then prove the ink is yours. Speak a truth, or a lie, and I will taste which.

choices.text: A name the murmurs gave me.

truth.speaker: The Void
truth.text: Truth. How quaint. It will not save you, but it is pretty while it lasts.

lie.speaker: The Void
lie.text: A [glitch]lie[/glitch]. The ink drinks those the fastest. You'll feel it thin.

name.speaker: The Void
name.text: You remember a [flicker]name[/flicker]. Old. Buried. The dark flinches to hear it spoken.

verdict.speaker: The Void
verdict.text: So. This is the light you are. Now show me how it ends.

ascend.speaker: The Void
ascend.text: Five sparks and a spine. [shake]Rare[/shake]. Go on then. Blind the deep, if you can.

end_descend.speaker: The Void
end_descend.text: Down, then. It always was. The ink will meet you at the bottom.

end_draw.speaker: The Void
end_draw.text: You drew your way in. [wave]Draw[/wave] your way through. I will be the paper.
